tasks.label: Seed dev env from prod
tasks.command: mkdir -p "$HOME/Library/Application Support/githuttbr-dev" && rm -f "$HOME/Library/Application Support/githuttbr-dev/"githuttbr-* && cp "$HOME/Library/Application Support/GitHuttBr/"githuttbr-* "$HOME/Library/Application Support/githuttbr-dev/" 2>/dev/null; exit 0
